participation.context: Closed the hire at the sixteen days and took no new line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You accepted sixteen days at twelvepence and refused the gall as a separate charge. You placed the sixteen inside the journey's about thirty-eight shillings. You did not name a new sum.

title: Let sixteen days at twelvepence stand

participation.context: Took the note, set the unpacking order, and spoke to the cat.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Delivered the parish and the note, and set the bag's deadline at tonight.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Reported the cat, the pane, and a quiet lodger.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Heard from the back room. He was not renamed.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: the bag out of the passage tonight
relations.quote: That hired bag goes out tonight.

story.body: You heard two banns, one pane, and a rehearsal at nine. You accepted the bag's exile tonight. You put Anne's list ahead of your own papers and did not read it out. You moved the claim on the book off the cat and onto Field. You did not ask Verbeke to be anyone but himself.

relations.note: the bag out of the passage tonight
relations.quote: That hired bag goes out tonight.

title: Heard Heminges's Friday note and unpacked Anne's list first

participation.context: Counted, wrote the four lines and the total, and did not continue.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the date, the four lines, and the count under them. The four shillings from home were inside the £19 6s. You stopped. The evening took the sleep, not a further page.

title: Counted the coffer and cast the journey in four lines
